reference_configuration.usage: Illustrative/reference operating configuration only. Main claims must be based on policy frontiers and sensitivity ranges, not one chosen parameter point.

realized_loss_rule.post_gather_execute: c_G + C(v) if y_t1_d1 != SAFE_TO_EXECUTE, else c_G

argmax_gather_convention: ARGMAX does not use t1 continuation; if it predicts GATHER, the simulation applies GATHER cost then the cheaper non-autonomous fallback (ESCALATE or ABSTAIN) for end-to-end loss accounting.
governance: Do not choose a single tau0, beta0, tau1, beta1, or cost schedule because it looks best on the test set.
Report predeclared grids/frontiers and the frozen reference configuration.
Training-only statistics may be used for consequence normalization; test outcomes may not be used to redefine policy parameters.
Step-09a.5 risk-cap operating points are descriptive diagnostics and are not reused as prospectively tuned thresholds.
No special R4 policy override is permitted in the primary analysis.
interpretation: Do not select a preferred parameter point from test performance. Use predeclared frontiers/sensitivity ranges plus the frozen reference configuration.
